title: Operations Supervisor - Distribution
description:
This position is for a startup operation located in Monee, IL

Second shift 2:30 PM - 10:30 PM


Operations Supervisor - Distribution

The Operations Supervisor role has a national salary range of $62,500 - $70,000.

For roles in California the range is $70,304 - $82,000 and for roles in Washington the range is $80,169 - $82,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase, 401K and a generous PTO policy.


As an Operations Supervisor at DHL Supply Chain, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of our warehouses. Your responsibilities go beyond daily management – you will be instrumental in implementing processes to optimize our warehouse operations. Your leadership will be vital in guiding our frontline associates, fostering a safe and productive work environment, and ultimately driving the overall success of DHL Supply Chain. This position offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact within DHL Supply Chain and contribute to our renowned reputation as the global leader in contract logistics.


With over 500 facilities and more than 50,000 dedicated associates, DHL Supply Chain North America attributes its success to the hard work and dedication of our team, operating in over 150 million square feet of warehouse space.


Job Description:

  • Lead, motivate and develop a diverse team of frontline associates by providing coaching, guidance, and support as needed, while also developing a strong team culture of inclusion and belonging.
  • Take proactive measures to consistently uphold compliance with health and safety regulations, fostering a culture of heightened safety awareness throughout the organization.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics to track performance and identify areas of improvement. Provide regular reports and analysis to management, highlighting achievements, challenges, and recommendations for enhancing warehouse operations.
  • Foster an environment of open communication and collaboration, facilitating regular and effective dialogue among leadership and associates to promote transparency, alignment, and teamwork.


Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, preferred.
  • 1+ years operations experience in a lead/supervisor/management role, preferred.
  • 1+ years logistics industry experience, preferred.
  • Staff management, workload planning, objective setting and organizational skills, preferred.

Our Organization has a business casual environment and focuses on teamwork, associate development, training, and continuous improvement.

Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

  • Manage the flow of project information between the project team through regular meetings and written communications
  • Forecast and update key project milestones

title: Senior SAP Engineer
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior SAP Engineer to join our team full-time in Slovakia.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior SAP Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Define, document, test and validate business integration logic from source systems through to Kinaxis Maestro. The integration specialist is expected to be the link between the Kinaxis Maestro product team and the integration/development team supplying the required data objects to support the technical functionality of Kinaxis Maestro. The SAP/BTP specialist is expected to be able to collaborate closely with the assigned Solution Architect to understand and translate the functional requirements to technical integration mappings.

Scope of work:

The SAP/BTP Specialist will be contracted to design, extend, and validate integrations between internal & external source systems and Kinaxis.

  • Designing and delivering new interfaces where required between Source Systems and Kinaxis Maestro
  • Adjust Kinaxis Data Model & Data Sources and Mappings according to solution needs for EMS
  • Adjust/set up integration in BTP from various source systems
  • Designing and delivering integrations with External Manufacturers to get data into Kinaxis Maestro platform (stock, planning, capacity, order, others)
  • Ensuring consistency with the established integration architecture, standards, and SAP BTP integration approach

Take ownership of integration design and validation for the in-scope planning domains and act as the primary integration point between:

  • Business and Product stakeholders
  • Kinaxis Maestro functional and product teams
  • SAP integration and development teams

Responsibilities:

  • Develop integrations between source systems and Kinaxis Maestro
  • Collaborate with Product Team and Solution Architect to define data object requirements and specifications for Data Model
  • Translate business requirements to technical mappings between SAP and Kinaxis Maestro
  • Work closely with developers to follow preferred integration approach using SAP BTP approach
  • Define and execute test cases in collaboration with business and test manager to validate mappings, data quality and business logic
  • Ensure clear and comprehensive documentations
  • Ensure testing E2E of data objects and integrations between product teams

Requirements:

  • Proven experience with ABAP
  • Proven experience with SAP BTP
  • Proven experience with SAP
  • Deep working knowledge of SAP ECC data structures relevant to planning/supply chain
  • Solid understanding of BAPI-based write paths vs. direct table manipulation, and the data-consistency risks of bypassing standard APIs
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA data model differences from ECC (especially where table structures or field semantics change)
  • Hands-on experience building and operating integrations on SAP BTP
  • Practical experience with both synchronous (API-based) and asynchronous (event/queue-based) integration patterns
  • Understanding of BTP security models (OAuth2, principal propagation, destination services)
  • Proven experience integrating SAP with non-SAP planning systems (fx APS systems)
  • Strong written documentation skills — specs need to survive handoff to other engineers/contractors

Desirable:

  • Direct Kinaxis Maestro experience, especially integration
  • Prior involvement in an ECC-to-S/4HANA migration specifically for planning/supply chain modules
  • Familiarity with SAP Master Data set ups
  • Background in manufacturing/supply chain domain
  • Certification in SAP BTP or Integration Suite

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door culture that values initiative and empowers its people to succeed
  • Fast-paced & agile environment: Be part of a dynamic, fast-moving organization that champions efficiency and innovation
  • Global exposure: Collaborate with international, cross-functional teams and contribute to large-scale initiatives
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Flexibility: Balance office and remote work to fit your rhythm
  • Care: Take advantage of our extensive benefits offering, aligned with the best market standards

The salary starts at 2900 Euro gross. The final salary depends on the previous experience and professional knowledge of the candidate.

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

Our Slovakia hub brings together passionate professionals working on global initiatives. Be part of a close-knit team that’s driving digital transformation and creating lasting impact.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

title: Program Coordinator (Adult Day Program)
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Friends of Children with Special Needs (FCSN) is a Bay Area non-profit organization founded in 1996 and focused on helping individuals with special needs and their families find love, hope, respect, and support through integrated community involvement. Under the supervision of Program Manager, the Adult Day Program Coordinator manages and evaluates the daily operations; supervises Program Instructors; enhances quality of service delivery and Person-Centered Thinking (PCT) implementations; conducts ISP meetings; builds and maintains relationships with stakeholders; acts as the designated emergency leader when supervisor is not available; establishes collaborations with community partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Program Management
1. Provide comprehensive program management services to optimize participants' success. This includes coordinating resources; supervising tailored training; monitoring participants' wellbeing; promoting participants’ personal growth; handling safety and emergencies; and offering ongoing support.
2. Oversee the day-to-day operations and execution of quality service delivery. Develop and implement solutions to overcome obstacles.
3. Supervise and implement behavioral support plan, positive behavioral prevention strategies and intervention techniques.
4. Develop comprehensive PCT Individualized Service Plan (ISP); Conduct participants’ semi-annual and annual ISP meetings with the interdisciplinary team; and supervise the implementation of participants’ ISP objectives.
5. Enhance program quality, supervise/ensure the developments of innovative curriculum, and monitor training effectiveness for program participants.
6. Develop monthly class/training/activity/community integration schedule based on participants’ interests, preferences, skills, and needs to enrich their lives and promote overall skills and optimal health.
7. Supervise the quality/maintenance of consumer records and staff’s files, documentations, and operations to meet CCL and RC’s requirements.
8. Submit SIR, APS report to parents, conservators, RC, CCL and/or APS in a timely manner.
9. Maintain effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.
10. Communicate effectively with Program Manager for participants’ status, staff’s performances, and program quality.
11. Participate, inspire and involve staff/participants/families in FCSN special events and fundraisers.

• Staff Supervision
1. Provide initial orientation and shadowing for new hires; review their performances and provide constructive feedback.
2. Conduct ongoing training, facilitate meetings and provide close supervision to promote staff’s proficiency.
3. Supervise, mentor and evaluate staff's performance, PCT implementations and documentations to ensure quality, accuracy and compliance with program standards.
4. Promote open communication with staff and foster a positive and inclusive workplace that inspire and motivate the team to deliver their best work.
5. Be a role model for the team and proactively analyze team morale and actively plan for team building activities to foster staff team work and retention.
6. Conduct semi-annual and annual Performance Evaluation on staffs.

• Emergency Preparedness and Handling
1.Conduct and document fire/earthquakes/medical drills monthly, earthquake drills quarterly, community safety quarterly, and evacuation practices quarterly.
2. Handle emergencies and be the acting/interim supervisor when Program Manager is not available.

• Community Representation
1. Represent FCSN to communicate with parents, consumers, Regional Center representatives, and other collaborative agencies
2. Engage in outreaches, special events and fairs to promote FCSN’s publicity.

REQUIREMENTS:
1. Education: An associate's degree in a human services field is required; a bachelor's degree or higher education is preferred.
2. Experience: Minimum of two-year experience in working in the developmentally disabled field.
3. Professional Skills
• Knowledge of developmental disabilities, CCL regulations, RC system, Lanternman Act, DDS
• Excellent behavioral management skills.
• Excellent people skills and problem solving skills.
• Proficient in using Microsoft Office applications, Google Drive, Presentation applications.
• Excellent oral and written communications skills and the ability to work effectively and independently.
4. Environmental Conditions
• Able and willing to perform tasks that may involve lifting (25 lbs), bending, and assisting with personal care and mobility needs.
• Must have a reliable vehicle with full car insurance (proof of vehicle insurance), clean DMV record and willing to transport participants in personal vehicle for participants’ traveling needs.
• Extensive amount of time driving and transporting clients in the community, standing and walking.
5. Personality Traits:
• Take initiative, demonstrate flexibility, respond positively to assignments, and actively execute plans.
• Able to multitask, quick learner with high energy, professionalism, and possessing strong organizational, time management, and computer skills.
• Professional, energetic, detail-oriented, and reliable.
• Remain positive, resilient, and calm when dealing with challenges.
• Able to motivate and maintain effective working relationships with the staff team.

COMPANY-WIDE HIRING REQUIREMENTS:
• Must pass DOJ fingerprint-based background clearance prior to employment.
• Must pass a health screening and TB test prior to employment.
• Must possess a valid California driver's license, clean DMV printout, and current automobile insurance.
• Obtain valid CPR and First Aid Certificate within one month of employment (covered by employer).

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS:

title: Senior Heavy Civil & Earthworks Engineer
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role description:

We are seeking a Senior Heavy Civil and Earthworks Engineer to join our field-based construction supervision team in Vancouver. The role suits an engineer who has come up through heavy civil construction and who knows how large earthmoving and concrete operations actually run, what they cost in time when they go wrong, and what has to be right before the next activity starts.

This is a full-time site-based position. The Senior Heavy Civil and Earthworks Engineer supervises the heavy civil scope during Engineering Services During Construction, covering bulk earthworks and reclamation, cast in place and precast concrete structures, retaining walls, culverts and crossings, pavements and roadworks, hardstands and yard areas, site grading and drainage, temporary works and the civil interfaces with marine, utility and building packages.

The position carries Engineer of Record responsibility for the heavy civil works under supervision, including the conduct and documentation of field reviews, the acceptance of workmanship and materials, and the certification that the constructed works substantially conform with the design. The role is not a design office position and does not involve production work in design or modelling software. It is also distinct from the geotechnical field engineering function. Ground behaviour, instrumentation interpretation and ground improvement verification sit with the geotechnical Engineer of Record, and this role works alongside that person rather than duplicating them.

Role accountabilities:

In this role you will act as the Engineer of Record for the heavy civil works under your supervision. You will set and carry out the field review programme, document each review, apply your professional seal where required, and certify substantial conformance with the design documents, the specifications and the applicable codes.

You will supervise the construction of civil structures on site, covering excavation and formation, blinding, formwork and falsework, reinforcement fixing and cover, concrete placement, finishing and curing, joint and waterstop installation, precast erection and connection, and the installation of embedded items and fixings. You will hold inspection points before pour and before cover, and you will release work only when it is right.

You will supervise bulk earthworks as a construction operation, covering the sequencing of cut, haul and fill, the management of haul roads and working platforms, layer placement and control, the balance between borrow, stockpile and disposal, and the coordination of earthworks with the structures, utilities and marine fronts so that the works do not block one another. You will review the contractor plant, resourcing and production assumptions against the programme and raise the shortfall early when the numbers do not support the dates.

You will supervise roadworks and pavement construction through subbase, base, binder and surface courses, together with kerbs, drainage, culverts, crossings, barriers, signage and line marking, and you will confirm the finished levels, falls, tolerances and ride quality against the specification.

You will control setting out and survey verification for the civil works, reviewing the contractor survey control, checking as constructed levels and alignments against the drawings, and confirming that tolerances have been met before following on trades take over. You will review quantities, survey pickups and volume reconciliations to support measurement and the technical assessment of change.

You will review contractor submissions for the civil scope, including method statements, inspection and test plans, temporary works and falsework designs, lifting and access plans, concrete mix designs, material submittals and testing procedures, and you will confirm that what is proposed matches the design intent and can be built safely in the sequence proposed.

You will coordinate with the geotechnical Engineer of Record on formation acceptance, excavation support, dewatering, slope stability and ground improvement, taking the geotechnical position into your own acceptance of the civil works rather than forming it yourself. You will also manage the civil interfaces with the marine, utility, electrical and building packages, including block-outs, penetrations, plinths, tie ins and hand back of work fronts.

You will own the non conformance and corrective action process across the civil scope, support environmental controls including erosion and sediment control and concrete washout, contribute to site safety through inspections and temporary works oversight, and mentor field engineers and inspectors working on civil packages.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Minimum 15 years of engineering experience on heavy civil, transportation, ports, marine or large infrastructure projects, the greater part of it site based, with a strong field earthworks and geotechnical construction background
  • Bachelor’s degree in civil or Structure or Geotechnical Engineering, or an equivalent discipline
  • Registration as a Professional Engineer with EGBC, or eligibility for registration, is an asset. Registration is expected before mobilisation for candidates who will carry Engineer of Record duties and seal field review and assurance documentation. Equivalent Canadian or international registration is welcomed
  • Demonstrated experience acting as, or supporting, the Engineer of Record during construction, including documented field reviews and certification of substantial conformance for earthworks and civil packages
  • Demonstrated site supervision experience across bulk earthworks, ground improvement, preload and surcharge, retaining structures, pavements and drainage
  • Working knowledge of CSA A23.1 and A23.2, ASTM and CSA soils and aggregate testing methods, the BC Ministry of Transportation and Infrastructure standard specifications and municipal supplementary specifications such as MMCD
  • Practical familiarity with geotechnical instrumentation and the interpretation of monitoring data during construction
  • Understanding of erosion and sediment control practice and of provincial and federal environmental requirements applicable to earthworks
  • Ability to read construction drawings, survey data and quantity records and to reconcile them against what has been built in the field
  • Sound judgement in the field, with the ability to reach a position quickly when construction is waiting on an answer
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and experience of working alongside contractors in a fast-moving construction environment

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Women, minorities, people with disabilities and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.


The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $160,000. The base salary represents Arcadis’ hiring range for this position. Actual salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as location, skills, experience, and qualification for the role.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer

Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter.   • AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack

The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation.

Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum.

What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work.

Our values:

🌿 We make a positive impact.

✨ We aim for the stars.

💚 We care for each other.

Impact of a Senior Analytics Engineer

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you will join our Data Science and Engineering team at Upsun to help our company make smarter choices. You will do this by helping us better understand our customers and internal operations. You will work with large amounts of platform and business data to create clear insights that improve our product and decisions. In this role, you will use SQL, Python, DBT, Hex, Metabase, and GCP data tools. You will work on important projects like building new data models with Salesforce and financial data, or working with AI tools and cloud cost modeling (FinOps).

What to expect

  • Data Modeling and Architecture: You will design and build models that turn raw data into useful metrics and data products, using DBT and medallion architecture.
  • Metric Design & Ownership: You will define what success looks like for our products, setting up and tracking key business metrics.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You will work with technical and non-technical teams to collect requirements, share methods, and teach best practices for using data.

title: Civil / Environmental EIT (Entry Level)
description:
Your Opportunity

As a Civil / Environmental Engineer you will work with close guidance and supervision on tasks and smaller projects, and as a team member of a larger project under the guidance of a senior engineer/designer, you will participate in the evaluation, recommendation, and specification of engineering principles to select the best plan involving the collaboration with multiple stakeholders and expertise within the company. You will assist in verifying compliance with applicable codes and engineering standards/practices.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Works with other engineering disciplines and professionals in the coordination of the project under the direction of a senior engineer/ designer.
  • Performs field work as directed by a senior engineer/ designer.
  • Assists with basic engineering duties on projects of various complexity.
  • Perform hydrologic and hydraulic modeling.
  • Assist in stormwater master planning at a basin or watershed scale.
  • Assist in floodplain evaluations, including modeling and permit support.
  • Support power sector projects including existing infrastructure maintenance and new infrastructure design.
  • Assist in the design and analysis of stormwater management facilities.
  • Provide field support for water quality studies, watershed walkovers, stream assessments, and other projects.
  • Assist in civil site design and planning efforts.
  • Other duties or responsibilities as assigned by management.

Your Capabilities and Credentials

  • Knowledge of civil and environmental engineering concepts and techniques.
  • Willingness to participate and collaborate in project team setting and to engage in creative and critical thought.
  • Positive attitude and desire to learn, grow, and succeed.
  • Knowledge of stormwater planning and engineering.
  • Knowledge of hydraulics and hydrology analysis and modeling.
  • Knowledge of gradually varied flow calculations and modeling.
  • Knowledge of GIS mapping / analysis and AutoCAD drafting / standards.
  • Technical writing and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to help with schematic, conceptual, and final designs and construction plan preparation.
  • Ability to use hydrology and hydraulics software (e.g. HEC-RAS, SWMM, and/or Pond Pack) and Microsoft Office software.
  • Ability to perform moderate field work and walk 2-4 miles per day in rough terrain.
  • Ability to work in the field for long hours in all weather conditions.
  • Ability to communicate in a professional and positive manner, both in writing and in person, with clients, employees and visitors.
  • Ability to prepare reports and conduct studies.
  • Must have a good driving record and valid driver’s license.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) in Civil, Water Resources, Biological Systems, Environmental Engineering, or other similar degree is required. Minimum of 0-2 years of experience. Co-op/Internship experience preferred.

    Stantec is a global leader in sustainable engineering, architecture, and environmental consulting. The diverse perspectives of our partners and interested parties drive us to think beyond what’s previously been done on critical issues like climate change, digital transformation, and future-proofing our cities and infrastructure. We innovate at the intersection of community, creativity, and client relationships to advance communities everywhere, so that together we can redefine what’s possible. #StayInquisitive

description:
This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who wants to actively shape how Engineering, one of the most important parts of how Datadog develops its people.

You’ll own this work end to end, from the first framing conversation with senior leaders through to delivering a program running at scale.

AI is changing how Engineering builds software, and it is changing how People builds the programs that support Engineering too. This role sits at the centre of both: understanding how AI is reshaping engineering roles, skills and structures, and building AI-powered solutions within People to keep pace.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

title: Manufacturing Process Operator Trainee
description:
Primary Duties & Responsibilities

  • While under supervision, learn to operate, monitor, and maintain CVD production equipment and support systems. Responsible for performing tasks independently once training requirements have been met and indicated by individual sign-off procedure.

  • Accountable for the safe operation of CVD production equipment and support systems, safe handling and storage of H2S/H2Se (Hydrogen Sulfide/Hydrogen Selenide) gas cylinder inventory and processing of ZnS/ZnSe (Zinc Sulfide/Zinc Selenide) product.

  • Responsible for proper monitoring and data logging of CVD process and support equipment and systems and safety systems, including facility checks and reporting.

  • Monitor and log data for CVD processes, support equipment, and safety systems, including facility checks and reporting.

  • Strictly adhere to established procedures, policies, and protocols to reduce the risk of accidental release or exposure to highly toxic materials.

  • Participate in the Process Safety Management (PSM) process to maintain compliance with OSHA PSM and EPA Risk Management Plan (RMP) standards. Learn and follow DEP standards for safe handling and storage of hazardous waste.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in the CVD department

  • Actively participate in the Saxonburg Site Emergency Response Team (ERT), including successful completion of 40-hour HAZWOPER Technician Level training and meeting all continuing education requirements to stay active as a member of ERT.

Education & Experience

  • High school graduate or equivalent required.

  • 1 to 3 years of manufacturing experience preferred.

Skills

  • Basic understanding of chemistry and physics principles.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to following strict safety protocols.

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

  • Good manual dexterity and ability to work with small, delicate components.

  • Strong communication skills for accurate reporting and data logging.

  • Good computer skills for data entry and equipment interface operation.

  • Strong aptitude for learning complex technical processes and safety procedures.

  • Moderate mechanical aptitude is required for process connections and system maintenance.

  • Safe operation of process equipment requires a general understanding of pressure and fluid flow with the ability to evaluate process conditions to troubleshoot and correct minor process issues.

  • Must be able to communicate effectively with department management, maintenance, and trained CVD Systems operators/leads to address training needs, to support successful training and testing.

  • Must be able to understand and meet the MPZ CVD schedule, performance and operating requirements and demands.

  • Must learn to perform all aspects of a system operator safely and completely within training period.

  • Ability to model, lead, motivate, and influence effectively using I CARE values (Integrity, Collaboration, Accountability, Respect, Enthusiasm).

Working Conditions

  • Multiple-shift rotation to support a 24/7/365 operation.

  • Involves the handling and storage of toxic substances requiring significant attention to detail.

  • Regular exposure to dust, fumes, heat, noise and cold

  • Respirator, supplied air, and SCBA use required.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand or sit for up to 12 hours per day.

  • Ability to lift, push and pull up to 50#’s occasionally.

  • Must be able to climb, bend, reach, push and pull regularly.

  • Must be able to work on elevated surfaces such as ladders or mechanical lifts.

  • Must be able to wear required equipment during the performance of specified production and maintenance operations, as well as incident response.

  • Must be able to function mentally and physically while wearing safety equipment for extended periods.

  • Must be able to meet physical requirements to participate as an active member of the site Emergency Response Team.

Safety Requirements

All employees are required to follow the site EHS procedures and COHERENT Corporate EHS standards.

Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirements:

  • Must be able to wear proper PPE including safety glasses, goggle, splash shields, steel toe/metatarsal shoes, long pants, sleeved uniform, and hearing protection.
  • Must be able to wear dust mask, respirator, or supplied air for extended periods.
  • PFT + respirator Pre-employment physical.
  • PFT + respirator annual physicals (Emergency Response Team)

Pre-employment and annual screening requirements:

Quality and Environmental Responsibilities

Due to inventory quantities of some highly hazardous materials, MPZ is covered by OSHA standard for Process Safety Management, as well as EPA’s Risk Management program. All MPZ personnel are required to understand the importance of following all operating procedures to maintain regulatory compliance with these programs.

Due to classification of several process waste streams, DEP standards for Hazardous Waste handling and storage must be followed to ensure regulatory compliance.

Coherent meets the ISO 9001 quality standards. MPZ employees must understand and follow all applicable Quality Assurance policies and participate in audits to maintain ISO 9001 certification.

Failure to follow operating procedures could result in a release of hazardous materials, impacting employees and the environment.

Culture Commitment

Ensure adherence to company’s values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position at Coherent Corp.:

Integrity – Create an Environment of Trust

Collaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas

Accountability – Own the Process and the Outcome

Respect – Recognize the Value in Everyone

Enthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work

Coherent Corp. is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at talentacquisition@coherent.com.

title: Public Assistance (PA) Project Delivery Manager

  • Monitor project activities against prescribed deadlines.

  • Qualified applicants who are offered a position must pass a pre-employment substance abuse test.
  • This position is subject to a pre-employment criminal background check and a motor vehicle records check.

  • Experience delivering PA Assistance on at two or more previous disasters.

  • Possess flexibility to respond to and manage different tasks, often with competing priorities;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills;
  • Ability to work in a team environment;

title: Product Portfolio Director – Digital Energy Products
description:
We are looking for a Digital Product Portfolio Director to shape the future of DNV's portfolio of digital products and data-driven solutions supporting critical energy infrastructure.

This is a highly strategic leadership role for an experienced digital product professional who can operate across products, platforms, markets, and business lines. You will play a key role in helping DNV navigate the rapidly evolving energy landscape by ensuring our digital product portfolio continues to create value for customers, supports business growth, and strengthens our market position.

The digital portfolio has evolved over time through a number of independent products, each addressing specific customer needs and market opportunities. As the portfolio matures, there is a significant opportunity to create greater value by strengthening strategic alignment, leveraging shared capabilities, and adopting a more platform-centric approach. You will play a pivotal role in shaping this evolution, working with Product Managers to help transform a collection of successful products into a more cohesive, scalable, and market-leading product ecosystem.

What you will do

  • Define and own the long-term digital product portfolio and platform strategy, aligning investments, product direction, and platform evolution with business objectives, customer needs, and market opportunities.
  • Lead the transformation of independent product lines into a cohesive, platform-driven product ecosystem with a clear strategic identity, differentiated value proposition, and scalable operating model.
  • Challenge, coach, and mentor product teams, implementing professional product management practices and ensuring portfolio-wide alignment around customer value, business outcomes, and long-term growth objectives.
  • Drive portfolio investment, prioritization, and lifecycle decisions, balancing innovation, growth opportunities, platform development, modernization, and product rationalization.
  • Establish strategic governance across the portfolio, ensuring product roadmaps contribute meaningfully to the long-term portfolio vision while enabling alignment between product, technology, and business priorities.
  • Continuously assess portfolio performance to identify gaps, overlaps, risks, and emerging opportunities, recommending optimization actions that maximize customer impact, commercial value, and competitive advantage.
  • Serve as the principal strategic advisor to Product, Technology, and Business teams, challenging and influencing portfolio investment decisions, strategic priorities, and long-term direction through insight, credibility, and market expertise.

Success in this role requires a unique combination of digital product leadership, strategic thinking, commercial awareness, coaching and mentoring, and influence. You will partner with Product Managers, Technology leaders, Commercial teams, and senior stakeholders across the organization to guide decisions, challenge assumptions, and ensure the portfolio evolves in line with customer needs, market dynamics, and long-term business objectives.

  • The opportunity to influence strategic growth in a rapidly scaling global digital business.
  • A high-exposure role with direct interaction with customers, partners, and senior leadership.
  • Participation in building next-generation digital solutions combining data, AI, and domain expertise.
  • A collaborative and international environment.
  • Flexible working arrangements and a strong focus on work–life balance.

**Benefits vary based on position, tenure, location, and employee election**

DNV is a proud equal-opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, or business need, without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

  • 10+ years of experience in Digital Product Management, including at least 5 years in Product Portfolio Management, with a proven track record of defining, scaling, and optimizing digital products and product portfolios within complex global organizations.

  • Proven ability to coach, challenge and influence Product Managers and experience in implementing best practice in Product Management within diverse teams
  • Experience in delivering results through cross-functional teams, ensuring product strategies and roadmaps align with portfolio objectives and deliver meaningful customer and business value.
  • Experience in the energy sector, with a strong understanding of the customer challenges, market dynamics, and digitalization trends shaping the energy transition.
  • Proven experience defining and executing product and portfolio strategies, translating customer needs, market opportunities, and business objectives into product vision, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong expertise in product portfolio and lifecycle management, including strategic prioritization, investment planning, portfolio optimization, product rationalization, and end-of-life decisions.
  • Deep understanding of platform-based product models and product ecosystems, with experience leveraging shared capabilities, data, and technology platforms to drive scale, innovation, and consistency across multiple products.
  • Strong strategic, analytical, and commercial acumen, with exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills and a demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment in complex matrix organizations without direct authority.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills

  • We conduct pre-employment background screening

    Please note all Resumes must be submitted in English

    *Immigration-related employment benefits, for example visa sponsorship, are not available for this position*

This role requires a strategic, forward‑looking mindset with a clear focus on long‑term value creation. You operate comfortably in ambiguity, bringing structure, clarity, and focus to complex portfolio challenges and enabling effective decision‑making with incomplete information. Success depends on your ability to influence without authority—building trust, aligning diverse stakeholders, and driving outcomes through insight and credibility. A collaborative approach, constructive challenge, and a strong sense of ownership and accountability enable you to operate effectively as a senior individual contributor and drive impact through others.

title: Senior Delivery Manager - Enterprise Data & Analytics - Remote
description:
The Senior Delivery Manager is responsible for driving the timely and predictable delivery of Enterprise Data & Analytics initiatives on behalf of business owners and product, engineering, and data and analytics teams. This role ensures requirements are captured, validated, tracked, and delivered through strong execution discipline, operational governance, and release coordination.

The Senior Delivery Manager partners closely with product, platform, analytics, AI/ML, and informatics leaders to plan, sequence, and manage work across multiple teams. The role provides visibility into delivery health, manages dependencies across products and platforms, and ensures delivery risks, issues, and release readiness are actively managed in alignment with enterprise priorities.

Key responsibilities include:
• Drive end‑to‑end delivery execution for Enterprise Data & Analytics initiatives, ensuring work is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned to agreed priorities
• Partner with product and technical leaders to plan and maintain delivery roadmaps, manage resource allocation and forecasting, and support financial and capacity management
• Lead sprint and Agile delivery operations, including backlog readiness, scrum standards, throughput and flow metrics, and team health indicators
• Coordinate program‑level and enterprise release management, including release calendars, dependency management, integrated release gates, and release readiness reviews
• Manage cross‑team and cross‑platform dependencies, identifying risks and escalating issues that impact schedule, quality, or delivery commitments
• Run delivery governance activities, including milestone reviews, risk and issue tracking, decision documentation, and evidence capture to support audit‑ready execution
• Establish and enforce quality and delivery controls, including definitions of done, validation requirements for high‑risk deliverables, and go‑live readiness gates
• Coordinate go‑live activities by producing and maintaining deployment plans, runbooks, implementation checklists, and release communications
• Maintain delivery and release documentation, including dependency maps, release artifacts, and notification plans
• Continuously improve delivery and release processes, tooling, and workflows (e.g., ADO/Jira hygiene, intake‑to‑backlog flow, automation of checklists and evidence)
• Communicate delivery status, risks, dependencies, and changes clearly to business owners, leadership, and stakeholders

Bachelor's degree and 5+ years' experience in digital product delivery management, scrum master, or another equivalent role. Able to effectively communicate/ translate a product vision, strategy and design amongst product, engineering/IT, UX/UI, Operations teams. Continuously seeks to understand new and emerging digital technologies and health care products and adapts work processes to reflect changes in design, build and delivery approaches. Understands and creatively problem-solves to remove obstacles to enable digital product delivery (on-time, within budget, and fulfilling documented requirements). Possesses technical knowledge and expertise working with engineering/IT teams. Ability to build and maintain strong working relationships at multiple levels of the organization. Effective (or Strong) communicator (written & verbal) with active listening skills. Ability to facilitate small group/team discussions. Professional and reflects Mayo Clinic values and beliefs. Strong planning & organizational skills. Proactive and able to navigate conflict and help find resolution. Problem solver with ability to maintain a keen attention to detail and manage multiple initiatives. Strong familiarity with Scrum – Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Advanced Certified Scrum Master (ACSM), PMI Agile Certified Practitioner, or Certified Scrum Professional (CSP) preferred. title: Azure Database Engineer (Contractor) - MNSITE-3832
description:
RESPEC is seeking an experienced Azure Database Engineer to support a Minnesota public-sector client on a high-impact child welfare modernization initiative. As a RESPEC consultant, you will join a mission-driven team working to strengthen data infrastructure that supports services for children, youth, and families across Minnesota.

Role Summary

This role will help advance the modernization of Minnesota’s child welfare information environment through the implementation of a Comprehensive Child Welfare Information System (CCWIS). A central component of this effort is consolidating data from 87 county databases into a centralized Azure-based data lake environment that will support a future enterprise solution.

The Azure Database Engineer will contribute across analysis, design, development, implementation, administration, maintenance, and security of Azure databases and Data Lakehouse capabilities. This individual will also collaborate with technical and business stakeholders, improve data workflows, help protect sensitive information, and mentor other database engineers.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, implement, administer, and maintain Azure database and data lake solutions supporting the CCWIS modernization program.

  • Support the development and ongoing evolution of a centralized Data Lakehouse and integrated data reserves.

  • Help consolidate and prepare data originating from 87 county database environments for use within a centralized platform.

  • Implement and maintain data security, integrity, governance, availability, and reliability practices within Azure environments.

  • Analyze and optimize data workflows to improve performance, usability, and data-driven decision-making.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including technical, program, and business stakeholders, to deliver scalable data solutions.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other Database Engineers.

  • Potentially provide ongoing operational support following implementation.

Required Technical Experience

Candidates should demonstrate strong, relevant experience in the following areas:

  • Azure database engineering, administration, maintenance, and security.

  • Azure Data Lakes, Data Lakehouse platforms, and centralized data-storage solutions.

  • Database analysis, design, development, and implementation.

  • Data integration, workflow optimization, data integrity, and data-security practices.

  • Working collaboratively across cross-functional technical and business teams.

  • Providing technical mentorship to other database engineering professionals.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting large-scale public-sector data modernization programs, child welfare systems, multi-source data consolidation, or enterprise cloud migrations would be highly relevant to this engagement.

The primary goal will be to bridge the gap between PrismHR’s full suite of products and our clients’ prospect’s needs. As a highly respected internal and external resource, this position is expected to assist with maintaining demonstration environments and providing proof points to ensure our clients can foster greater relationships with prospective and current SMB clients. Additionally, this position will assist with the creation of content to be consumed by our end clients which includes building usable demo content and ensuring its ongoing relevance. Working within the PrismHR culture also means consistent collaboration internally including updating/maintaining demo talk tracks for various product lines and working with Senior Sales Engineers to learn newly added PrismHR and PrismHR reseller products to be used in demos.

  • Understanding of the PrismHR platform and our target industries including PEO/ASO/HCM, Payroll Service Bureaus, and/or Staffing organizations is preferred
  • Prior system implementation, especially of PrismHR products or competitor products is highly valued

Education & Experience
  • Bachelor's degree or additional degree(s) preferred
  • 1+ years of technical solution presentations preferable
  • 1+ years of HCM experience including benefits, payroll, recruitment or time and attendance software is required.


Physical, Mental, & Communication Demands

Physical Demands:
  • Sedentary Work: Primarily involves sitting for extended periods, often at a desk or computer.
  • Manual Dexterity: Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment.
  • Mobility: Occasional walking or traversing throughout the office to meet with leaders and other employees.
  • Visual Acuity: Ability to read and analyze data on a computer screen (or to read and analyze data with reasonable accommodation) and in printed materials.
  • Lifting & Carrying: Minimal physical lifting required, but may involve handling documents, and lifting light office supplies.
Mental Demands:
  • Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy needed for managing client accounts.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to troubleshoot issues related to client escalations or complaints.
  • Multitasking: Manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously, often under tight deadlines.
  • Decision-Making: Make informed decisions regarding when it is appropriate to escalate client concerns or issues.
  • Stress Management: Handle stressful situations calmly and effectively, especially when dealing with client concerns
Communication Demands:
  • Interpersonal Skills: Strong ability to build relationships and communicate effectively with employees, managers, clients and external vendors.
  • Cultural Sensitivity: Communicate with individuals from diverse cultural backgrounds, demonstrating cultural awareness and sensitivity.
  • Written Communication: Prepare clear and concise documentation, including emails and notes.
  • Verbal Communication: Conduct presentations and employee training sessions; provide clear instructions and support to clients, employees and managers.
  • Presentation Skills: Present information effectively in training sessions with clients and other employees.

In office on site 5 days a week during normal working hours at Vensure office location.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our team full-time in India.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Data Scientist, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Apply evaluation-driven development practices across all modeling work: define success criteria before building, and validate against them throughout the lifecycle
  • Select the appropriate modeling approach for the problem at hand — statistical modeling, classical ML, optimization, simulation, or GenAI — based on data characteristics, interpretability needs, and business context, rather than defaulting to a single technique
  • Define evaluation metrics that map directly to business and process outcomes (e.g., cost savings, cycle-time reduction, forecast accuracy, decision quality), not just model-centric metrics (accuracy, F1, RMSE) in isolation
  • Use a combination of synthetic data, historical data, and real-world validation to test model performance, robustness, and edge-case behavior before and after deployment
  • Demonstrate and document measurable improvements in decisions, processes, or outcomes as a required part of every delivery — not an afterthought.
  • Own delivery of assigned workstreams within 45-day versioned agile release cycles, ensuring each release ships incremental, measurable value to stakeholders
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate business problems into well-scoped modeling and analytics initiatives
  • Maintain clear versioning, documentation, and change logs across release cycles to support traceability and reproducibility
  • Build and deliver AI/ML platform components and analytics products on AWS, applying MLOps practices (CI/CD for models, model registries, monitoring, automated retraining pipelines)
  • Contribute to cost management and performance optimization for data and ML workloads (compute sizing, storage tiering, pipeline efficiency)
  • Support synthetic data generation, offline experimentation (A/B testing, shadow deployments, backtesting), and controlled real-world validation of models before full rollout
  • Balance model performance against explainability, regulatory/compliance requirements, and infrastructure cost when selecting and tuning approaches
  • Partner with risk, compliance, and governance functions as needed to ensure models meet audit and explainability standards

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
  • 5–8+ years of experience delivering data science, ML, or analytics solutions in production environments
  • Demonstrated experience across multiple modeling paradigms: statistical modeling, machine learning, optimization, simulation, and exposure to GenAI applications
  • Hands-on experience with AWS-based ML/data platforms (e.g., SageMaker, S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda) and MLOps tooling
  • Practical experience with synthetic data generation techniques, offline experimentation frameworks, and controlled validation methodologies
  • Strong proficiency in Python/R/SQL and standard ML libraries
  • Experience working in agile delivery models with short, versioned release cycles
  • Ability to communicate technical trade-offs (performance vs. explainability vs. cost) to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Desirable:

  • Experience with explainability frameworks (SHAP, LIME) and model risk/compliance documentation
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM-based solution design and evaluation
  • Familiarity with cost-monitoring tools for cloud ML workloads (e.g., AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies)

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

title: Senior Resident Engineer - Ports, Marine & Heavy Civil Infrastructure
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role description:

As part of our continued growth in Western Canada, we are seeking an experienced Senior Resident Engineer to lead our field-based construction supervision team in Vancouver. The role suits a technically strong and self-motivated professional who has spent the greater part of a career on site delivering large and complex infrastructure works in the marine, ports, coastal, heavy civil, roads, rail and transit sectors.

This is a full-time site-based position. The Senior Resident Engineer is the senior representative of the engineering team during Engineering Services During Construction, taking the works from design completion through construction, commissioning and project completion certification. The role carries day to day responsibility for the conduct of site supervision, for the technical integrity of the constructed works, and for the working relationship between the design team, Arcadias subcontractors, the contractor, the owner’s engineer and the client.

The position carries Engineer of Record responsibility for the works under supervision, including the planning, conduct and documentation of field reviews, the confirmation that construction substantially conforms with the design intent and the applicable codes, specifications and the certification and assurance documentation that follows from that. The successful candidate will spend the working day among the works, the contractor and the inspection team.

Role accountabilities:

In this role you will lead and direct the site engineering and inspection team, allocating resources across work fronts, setting inspection priorities and confirming that every discipline is covered as construction progresses. You will chair site meetings, represent the engineering team in progress and coordination meetings with the contractor and the client, and keep senior management informed of technical risk as it develops.

You will act as the Engineer of Record representative for the works under your supervision or coordinate the discipline Engineers of Record where the works are split by discipline. You will set the field review programme, carry out and document field reviews at the frequency the work demands, apply your professional seal to field review records and assurance documentation, and confirm that the constructed works substantially conform with the design documents, the applicable codes and the permit conditions. Where they do not, you will say so in writing and see the matter resolved.

You will review and respond to contractor submissions including method statements, inspection and test plans, shop drawings, temporary works proposals and quality records, and you will confirm that the permanent works are built to the issued for construction documents and to the project specifications. Where site conditions differ from those assumed in design, you will raise the matter promptly with the design team, assess the consequences and see the resulting change through to a closed technical position.

You will administer the technical elements of the construction contract, including the review of contractor notices to Arcadis, the assessment of claims for extension of time and additional cost from an engineering standpoint, the issue of site instructions, and the recommendation of variations.

You will own the non conformance process on site, from identification through disposition and close out, and you will confirm that corrective actions have been implemented rather than only recorded. You will support punch listing, testing, commissioning, handover and completion certification, and you will oversee the preparation of record documentation.

You will take an active role in construction health, safety, environment and quality on site, setting the expectation for the engineering team, taking part in inspections and audits, and stopping work where the risk warrants it. You will also mentor resident engineers, field engineers and inspectors, building depth in the team and holding a consistent standard of engineering practice across the site.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Minimum 15 years of engineering experience, the greater part of it site based, in resident engineering, construction supervision or site engineering management roles on heavy civil, transportation, ports, coastal, marine or large infrastructure projects
  • Bachelor’s degree in civil, Structural or Geotechnical Engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline
  • Registration as a Professional Engineer with EGBC, or eligibility for registration, is an asset. Registration is expected before mobilization for candidates who will carry Engineer of Record duties and seal field review and assurance documentation. Applicants holding P.Eng registration in another Canadian jurisdiction or an equivalent international license such as PE or CEng or CPEng are encouraged to apply
  • Demonstrated experience acting as, or supporting, the Engineer of Record during construction, including documented field reviews, letters of assurance and certification of substantial conformance
  • Working knowledge of the EGBC professional practice requirements for documented field reviews and of the professional obligations attached to sealing construction phase documentation
  • Demonstrated experience leading a multidisciplinary site engineering and inspection team on projects of comparable value and complexity
  • Working knowledge of Canadian codes and standards applicable to heavy civil and marine construction, including CSA S6, CSA A23.1 and A23.2, CSA S16 and the British Columbia Building Code, together with relevant provincial and federal environmental, health and safety requirements.
  • Practical command of construction contract administration, including CCDC and similar forms, with experience of change management, claims assessment and the technical record that supports them
  • Sound judgement under work pressure, with the ability to reach a defensible position on site and to explain it clearly afterwards
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to hold a firm technical position with Arcadis’ subcontractor, contractors, stakeholders and regulators without damaging the working relationship
  • Experience of marine and in water construction methods, including dredging, reclamation, piling, jetties, precast placement and temporary works over water, is an asset
  • Willingness to be based full time on site, including work outside standard hours and during marine and tidal windows where the program requires it
  • Valid driving license and the site safety certification required for construction site access, including construction safety orientation and confined space and fall protection awareness where applicable

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Senior Environmental Planner - Transmission
description:
AECOM has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Environmental Planner - Transmission to join our Environmental Planning and Permitting (EPP) team in the Midwest region.

This hybrid role can be based out of AECOM's Indianapolis, Chicago, Milwaukee, Columbus, Minneapolis, St. Louis, Kansas City, or Detroit offices. Consideration will also be given for all locations in the Upper Midwest.

Our EPP team serves numerous private industry and public utility energy clients, on a variety of energy projects including transmission, grid modernization, and renewable energy developments. In this role you will lead project teams and work with our environmental planning practitioners and technical subject matter experts to prepare environmental documents, with a particular focus on supporting permitting and entitlement work for our growing line of work with energy developers and utilities. Projects range from regional transmission programs and grid modernization efforts to large-scale renewable energy developments and complex, multi-jurisdictional permitting efforts.

This role would involve serving as a seller-doer, responsible for developing and maintaining client relationships, leading pursuits and project teams, and expanding AECOM's energy permitting and environmental planning portfolio across the Midwest and supporting strategic growth initiatives throughout the U.S.

The responsibilities of this role would include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead environmental planning and compliance efforts for energy infrastructure projects, and coordination and filings with state utility regulatory agencies and public service commissions to support transmission siting, routing, permitting, and certificate approval processes across Midwest jurisdictions, especially within MISO, PJM, and SPP regions. Will include preparation of technical studies and NEPA documentation.
  • Manage early-stage due diligence efforts for siting energy projects and associated infrastructure.
  • Provide project management on mid- to large-sized projects, including developing and tracking project schedules, budgets, invoicing, and coordination with clients, technical staff and subconsultants.
  • Work on environmental documents and entitlements related to high-profile infrastructure projects, with particular emphasis on energy sector projects.
  • Support projects across the Midwest and other U.S. markets by leveraging AECOM's national technical and project delivery platform.
  • Contribute to marketing and business development, preparation of proposals, and formulating proposal cost estimates as a seller-doer.

title: CHAMP Roadside Motorist Patroller - District 3
description:
AECOM is actively seeking highly motivated individuals for the CHAMP (Coordinated Highway Assistance & Maintenance Program) in District 3. Starting Pay is $20hr.

District 3 covers the following areas: Thomaston, Columbus, Perry, Macon, & Lagrange, serving 31 counties within the West Central Georgia region. Georgia DOT's complimentary roadside assistance and maintenance service known as CHAMP (Coordinated Highway Assistance & Maintenance Program) is available to motorists traveling through the region.

CHAMP Operators play a key critical role in safeguarding motorists traveling the interstates by ensuring roadways are clear of debris, reporting highway maintenance issues and assisting stranded motorists, among other duties.

These dynamic roles are ideal for individuals with solid mechanical and/or automotive repair skills, a background in long- or short-term driving, public Safety, public Works and or ex-military.

Full-time CHAMP Operators will be provided with a company cell phone, radio, and a fully outfitted response vehicle while working on this program.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

  • Patrol and monitor a segment of interstate roadways in an assigned region, looking for stranded motorists, roadway deficiencies, site distance problems and obstructions that may cause lane blockage.
  • Requires strong communication skills for use with dispatch radio.
  • Provide strong customer service (no tips or gratuity can be accepted).
  • Professionally and courteously assist the public with circumstances that have left them stranded, such as dead batteries, running out of gas, or flat tires.
  • Ensure compliance with all Federal, State, and Municipal laws, rules and ordinances.
  • Monitor, report and document roadway deficiencies to Dispatch or District offices.

title: Software Engineer 3
description:
The Agent Research and Tooling team, part of MongoDB's AI Builder Experience organization, owns the platform layer around agents: how teams author, distribute, evaluate, monitor, and improve agent skills and agent behavior. We are hiring a software engineer to build and maintain the tooling, evaluation systems, and quality gates behind MongoDB's agent skills.

This is a software engineering role at the intersection of developer tooling, applied AI, and software quality. You will take loosely defined agent and tooling problems, break them into workable plans, and ship durable internal systems: command-line tools, reusable libraries, evaluation harnesses, and CI workflows.

This role is open to remote work in the US or can be based out of any of our US offices.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain agent skills and the infrastructure to validate, evaluate, publish, and maintain them
  • Design evaluation datasets and workflows that compare agent behavior against a baseline and produce actionable quality signals
  • Build agent metrics and observability: skill selection and routing, success and failure outcomes, tool calls, latency, and token usage
  • Design safety and quality gates for agent-authored content: rule packs, static analysis, confidence thresholds, structured verdicts, and bounded suppression
  • Create CLIs, libraries, and MCP integrations that other repositories adopt and that run in local development and CI
  • Integrate tooling into GitHub Actions and other CI workflows, including secrets, annotations, exit codes, and artifacts
  • Build code-generation quality checks, such as anti-pattern catalogs and linting for AI-generated MongoDB code
  • Investigate real failures such as nondeterministic results, false positives, and unsafe generated guidance, and turn them into reusable improvements
  • Collaborate with engineers, security partners, and product teams; communicate trade-offs, risks, and ownership across teams

Examples of the problems you'll solve

  • How can tests verify an agent tool's structured result when item order may vary, but counts, required fields, and values must remain correct
  • How can a CI gate flag unsafe instructions in an agent skill without treating every neutral mention as an incident or letting cautionary wording hide a real instruction
  • How can an evaluation suite show whether a skill improves answers over a baseline and give authors enough signal to improve it

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years of experience building production software, developer tools, internal platforms, or automation systems
  • Software engineering fundamentals in API design, testing, error handling, and maintainability
  • Experience building CLIs, libraries, test infrastructure, static analysis, or CI/CD workflows
  • Ability to design systems that are usable by developers and reliable in automation
  • Experience reasoning about correctness and safety with ambiguous input, nondeterministic output, false positives, or untrusted content
  • Comfort in an evolving R&D environment where the right abstraction emerges through prototypes and feedback
  • Written and verbal communication, including explaining technical trade-offs and aligning stakeholders across teams

Nice to have

  • Experience with agentic systems, LLM applications, prompt or rubric-based evaluation, or AI-assisted development
  • Experience building eval harnesses, benchmark datasets, quality metrics, LLM-as-judge workflows, or human-review tooling
  • Experience with Go, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C#
  • Experience with GitHub Actions security, secret handling, static rule engines, or policy enforcement
  • Experience moving prototypes into production

What success looks like

In your first year, you will:

  • Ship tooling that makes agent skills or developer workflows easier to test, review, and adopt
  • Improve the quality and interpretability of evaluations, not just their count
  • Convert recurring manual work and fragile scripts into documented, reusable automation
  • Make security, correctness, and operational trade-offs explicit in the designs you ship
  • Earn adoption from partner teams through clear interfaces and reliable CI
  • Own projects independently while collaborating on shared systems

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

title: ESIS Claims Representative, WC

title: Cyber Defense Analyst 3
description:
Swift is a privately held, mission-driven and employee-focused services and solutions company headquartered in Reston, VA. Our capabilities include Software Development, Engineering & IT, Data Science, Cyber Enablement, Logistics, and Training. Founded in 2019, Swift supports Civilian, Defense, and Intelligence Community customers across the country and around the globe.

We are looking for a Cyber Defense Analyst 3 to join a growing team in Annapolis Junction, MD.

Responsibilities:
  • Use cyber defense tools to monitor, detect, analyze, categorize, and perform initial triage of anomalous activity.
  • Generate cybersecurity cases (including event’s history, status, and potential impact for further action) and route as appropriate.
  • Perform advanced manual analysis to hunt previously unidentified threats.
  • Identify cyber-attack phases based on knowledge of common attack vectors and network layers, models and protocols.
  • Apply techniques for detecting host- and network-based intrusions.
  • Analyze malicious activity to determine weaknesses exploited, exploitation methods, effects on system and information.

title: Monitor Tech | FT | Nights
description:

The Monitor Technician is responsible for continuous surveillance of telemetry monitors to assess and document patient cardiac rhythms.   • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Knowledge of patient safety protocols and escalation processes.
